description: Check that every reference in a child dataset resolves to a parent. Containment is one-directional, which is the difference from a reconciliation: a parent key nothing references is normal and is reported as a count, while a child key with no parent is a broken reference reported with every row carrying it. Also catches a duplicated parent key, which makes any reference to it ambiguous. Pay 140000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

allow_empty_reference.description: Whether a child row with no reference at all is acceptable. Defaults to true, since an optional foreign key is a legitimate design.

child.description: The referencing dataset. Delimited text with a header row, at most 262144 bytes and 5000 data rows. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured. Nothing is fetched.

child_key.description: The matching columns in the child, which may be named differently but must be the same in number. A composite key is supported. Values are canonicalised exactly, so 42 and 42.0 are the same key and a large identifier is compared as text rather than collapsed.

delimiter.description: Single field separator. Defaults to a comma.

parent.description: The referenced dataset. Delimited text with a header row, at most 262144 bytes and 5000 data rows. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured. Nothing is fetched.
parent.example:
customer_id,name,region
C-001,Acme,ap-southeast-2
C-002,Globex,us-east-1
C-003,Initech,eu-west-1
C-003,Initech Duplicate,eu-west-1

parent_key.description: The key columns in the parent. A composite key is supported. Values are canonicalised exactly, so 42 and 42.0 are the same key and a large identifier is compared as text rather than collapsed.

name: referential_integrity_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the data was not, which is a different problem from data that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

row.description: 1-based and counting the header, so it matches a text editor.

intact.description: True only when both datasets were fully read, every parent key was unique, and every child reference resolved.

orphan_keys.description: Each unresolved reference with the rows carrying it.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

unreferenced_key_count.description: Parent keys nothing references. Reported as a count because it is normal.

title: Referential Integrity Audit
